notes: PB5304 confirmed on its decision, contested on one ground. The decision stands: §1989:A.2.11.3 RV1 prints the table PB191 decided for 2023 (00-13 ahead, 00-12 behind), one formatter (CobolDate.Format21) serves --std 85, and docs/CONFORMANCE.md's offset entry names this row and §1989:A.2.11.3 (lines 1006-1011 of the pinned tree). A +14:00 host has no in-range value: 14 leaves the range, 13 misreports the factor A.2.11.1 defines, and '0'/0000 asserts a facility the system has. Rerun and own boundary probes: +14:00 [2026030405060789+1400], -14:00 [...-1400] depart in positions 18-19 only; +13:00 +1300, +13:59 +1359, -12:00 -1200, -12:45 -1245, +00:00 +0000 conform. So the row is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT (a departure, bounded and documented), as PB5304 says, not CONFORMS. Contested: the 1985 "ground for documenting it" the entry and PB5304 name, §1985:I.1.5.2.1, covers elements "specified to be, in part, implementor defined"; RV1's ranges are not so specified (no implementor-defined wording in A.2.11.3, and the 1985 implementor-defined list does not name CURRENT-DATE: its item (82) points at §1989:A.2.3, which leaves to the implementor only the "characteristics of the returned value not otherwise specified" of NUMERIC and INTEGER functions, and CURRENT-DATE is alphanumeric with every position specified), so I.1.5.2.1 grants no latitude here. The departure is a documented non-conformance with I.1.5.2.2, which is exactly what DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT records; the CONFORMANCE.md sentence should say that instead of citing I.1.5.2.1 as a ground. The verdict does not change. Sibling: WHEN-COMPILED (§1989:A.2.46.3) prints the same 18-19 rows and shares the formatter. The departure is stated in docs/CONFORMANCE.md (the CURRENT-DATE / WHEN-COMPILED UTC-offset entry, corrected in this change to name it documented non-support of §1989:A.2.11.3 RV1 rather than §1985:I.1.5.2.1 latitude); the choice is kb/Work PB191 (owner decision), extended to this row by kb/Work PB5304 (adjudication: held-85/set8/decisions.json (the adjudication of coderead-85/held-9.json, the 1985 read 4)).
